summary: This note is an excerpt from a wiki article on Francis Bacon, covering his birth on 22 January 1561 at York House near the Strand in London. It describes his parentage, naming Sir Nicholas Bacon as his father and Anne (Cooke) Bacon as his mother, and notes his family connection to William Cecil, 1st Baron Burghley.
one_line: Francis Bacon's birth in London in 1561 and his aristocratic family connections, including his uncle Lord Burghley.
key_facts: Francis Bacon was born on 22 January 1561 at York House near the Strand in London.
Francis Bacon was the son of Sir Nicholas Bacon, who held the office of Lord Keeper of the Great Seal.
Sir Nicholas Bacon was Francis Bacon's father by his second wife, Anne (Cooke) Bacon.
Anne (Cooke) Bacon was the daughter of the noted humanist Anthony Cooke.
Anne (Cooke) Bacon was Francis Bacon's mother.
Anne Bacon's sister was married to William Cecil, 1st Baron Burghley.
William Cecil, 1st Baron Burghley, was Francis Bacon's uncle.
